title: Agent-facing federation status: read-only MCP/CLI view of hosts, links and peer state over existing routes
outcome: Greg has no UI. Agents therefore read the federation's state and each host's CPU, memory and disk usage through one supported read-only MCP/CLI facade instead of raw HTTP. The facade is a thin wrapper over the existing GET /api/federation and GET /api/federation/host-utilization routes. It adds no new state, sampler, authority or mutation. Agents decide where to place tasks themselves. Scope was agreed jointly by Fable2 and Kimi::Consultant (#133, #135) on Greg's word „niech uzgoni z KIMI”.
acceptance: One read-only MCP tool and matching CLI command form a thin wrapper over two EXISTING routes, GET /api/federation and GET /api/federation/host-utilization. They return those routes' bounded, redacted projection without changing its meaning. From the federation view: this host's role and identity, and (on Central) each peer's enrollment, verification, activation, link and worker attempt/park/quarantine state; on a satellite, the existing satellite block. From host utilization, per host: CPU busy percent and logical count; memory total/available/in-use; configured-volume total/free/available; measurement time and source age; every metric's state and reason, including stale/unavailable/unsupported; and rosterState/complete. No new sampler, aggregation, persisted state, field, authority, mutation, retry, recovery or placement logic. No running build is claimed. A verified profile binary hash may be shown only if already present, and only labelled as the verified profile. Historical lastObserved is never presented as the current link.

Deterministic tests cover: Central with several peers in different states (active, parked, quarantined, unverified, disconnected with stale utilization); a satellite; a standalone host; an incomplete or unavailable utilization roster; strict size bounds; and redaction. No pair secret, MAC or control payload, credential, path or unrestricted raw stderr appears. Tests check observable output, are not tautological, and read no Markdown or instruction files.

User docs describe the tool and the CLI command and link both ways with docs/features/federation-link.md and docs/features/host-utilization.md. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed input.

completion.summary: Delivered the bounded read-only federation status MCP tool and matching CLI over the existing federation and utilization routes. Landed in fdd8d035 with clean independent final pair and two same-tree landing FULLs; own registered landed-input focused check passed46 and native verification c64afb49 confirms its actual claim and root.
